title: Ramp council + interview scrub notes (Aug 19 2025)
content:
Meeting: Ramp Council + Interview Scrub
Date: 2025-08-19
Facilitator: Gina Morales
Attendees: Gina M., Omar D., Priya N., Evan L., Samira K., (notes pulled from Slack thread #ramp-council)
Objective: Quick sync on new hire ramps, collect buddy feedback, and review the last two interview pipelines to unblock hiring decisions. We want to capture specific follow-ups and adjust the buddy checklist based on recent pain points.

Summary / TL;DR
- Two new IC2 hires (full-stack infra track) started Aug 11. Early signals mixed: one strong on system design, struggling with infra runbook conventions; the other quick on code tasks but lower confidence in multi-team syncs.
- Interview panel recommended one hire (candidate C) for an offer pending reference check; flagged concerns about async comms and cross-team influence.
- Gap observed in ramp checklist: no explicit step for KV cache handoff + readme for serving-runtime. Add a 90-minute shadow pairing with runtime team in week 2.
- Action items assigned (see bottom). Proposed we pilot a shortened "first-30-days checklist" for infra hires with explicit on-call-lite exposure and a buddy pairing schedule.

Notes (detailed)
1) New hire updates (onboarded Aug 11)
  - H1 (L2 infra): Good throughput for assigned bugfixes (PRs merged: 3 small fixes). Struggling with the infra repo layout and default GH actions. Buddy (Omar) reported repeated context-switch overhead: 2–3 questions/day unresolved after standup.
  - H2 (L2 infra): Completed first feature branch and E2E on staging (latency regression caught early). Lower confidence in cross-team RFC review etiquette; tends to assume decisions rather than soliciting design feedback. Buddy (Priya) recommends explicit training on RFC process and review templates.
  - Suggested change: Add a 1:1 "RFC readshop" during week 2 for new infra hires — 30 minutes to run through examples, expectations, and templates.

2) Buddy program feedback (what's working / pain points)
  - Working: Weekly sched 2-hour buddy blocks are helpful for deep pairing. New hires value scheduled heads-down pairing instead of ad-hoc interrupts.
  - Pain: Buddies overwhelmed when new hires have multiple small urgent questions; no clear triage flow.
  - Proposal: Introduce a lightweight triage doc (template in /onboarding/buddy-triage.md) and set a 24-hour question backlog for non-urgent items. If unresolved after 24 hours, escalate to team lead.

3) Interview pipeline scrub (candidates interviewed 8/12–8/15)
  - Candidate A (platform infra): Strong in kernel-level reasoning and perf optimization. Interviewers liked depth but noted limited product context. Recommendation: hire if paired with rotations that emphasize product/product-metrics exposure.
  - Candidate B (infra-ops): Excellent debugging posture, weaker in design breadth. Panel recommends hire as a SWE2 with mentoring plan.
  - Candidate C (ops/infra hybrid): Consensus split — technical bar is ok, but behavioral concerns about async communication surfaced in two interviews (panelists cite examples of not following up in PR reviews). Interview lead (Evan) requests reference check focusing on cross-team collaboration history.
  - Action: Draft tailored interview feedback for recruiting to update scorecards (Rec: change "communication" rubric to include async PR follow-through observable).

4) Ramp metrics / early indicators to watch (first 30 days)
  - Signal set: PR throughput, mean time to first meaningful review, number of standalone deployments completed with guidance, participation in RFCs, number of unresolved buddy questions after 48h.
  - Baseline expectations: By day 14, 2 merged PRs that touch infra-critical paths OR 1 small deployment with checklist signoff.
  - Health flags: <2 merged PRs by day 14 + >5 unresolved buddy questions = 1:1 + 30-minute shadowing with team lead required.

5) On-call-lite pilot for early exposure (proposal)
  - Rationale: We observed new infra hires taking longer to get context for incidents. A supervised "on-call-lite" (no paging ownership but access to triage flow and read-only incident dashboards) during week 3 helps accelerate mental models.
  - Logistics: 4-hour slot on-call-lite with buddy, post-mortem reading, and a 30-minute debrief. Start with 2 volunteers (H1/H2) for pilot week Sep 8–12.

6) Knowledge artifacts missing / quick wins
  - Missing: KV cache handoff readme (serving-runtime) — several tickets this month depend on casual knowledge transfer.
  - Missing: Clear mapping of infra repos to deployment targets for new hires (repo -> service mapping).
  - Quick wins: Create a one-page "first deploy checklist" and a short Loom that walks through the staging deploy flow. Target: ready by Sep 2. Owner: Evan L.

7) Hiring funnel notes for recruiting
  - Reduce time between coding task and panel interview to <5 days. Long delays cause candidate drop-off.
  - Improve scorecard language for "communication" and "systems thinking" to reduce ambiguity between interviewers.
  - Recruiter ask: When offering, include a short technical mentor plan (2–3 bullets) to increase acceptance for mid-market candidates who care about growth.

Open questions / discussion items
- Do we formalize the on-call-lite into the default infra ramp playbook? (yes if pilot shows positive signal).
- How many buddy hours per week is sustainable for 1:1s? Current average is ~4.5 hours/week which buddies report as non-trivial overhead. Should we budget fractional time in next headcount plan?
- Can we add "async follow-through" examples in the PR rubric (concrete yes/no checklist)?

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Evan L.: Create first-deploy checklist + Loom explainer. Due: 2025-09-02. Linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-templates/pull/42
- Omar D.: Draft buddy triage template and post to /onboarding/buddy-triage.md. Due: 2025-08-26.
- Priya N.: Build RFC readshop agenda + add to week-2 schedule for infra hires. Due: 2025-08-25.
- Gina M.: Coordinate reference check for Candidate C (questions focused on async/PR follow-through). Due: 2025-08-21.
- Hiring lead (Samira K.): Update interview scorecards to include explicit async PR follow-through checkboxes and distribute to panel. Due: 2025-08-28.
- All buddies: Tally weekly buddy hours and submit approximate time-per-newhire for Q4 headcount planning. Due: 2025-09-05.

Appendix (snippets pulled from buddy Slack thread)
- Omar: "Note — H1 asked for a repo map twice this morning; I'll add a top-level README with service -> repo bullets."
- Priya: "Recommend a short RFC template during onboarding: context, constraints, decisions asked, who to consult. New hires seem to treat RFCs as 'final' docs rather than discussion starters."
- Samira: "If we require 2 buddy hours/day we need formal budget; I'll raise with eng-ops for Q4 planning."

Next meeting: Ramp council check-in Sept 2 (quick pulse, 30 minutes)
If you'd like edits to this note, drop comments here or ping Gina directly.
